title: Launch Tealeaf: KPI Funnel & Ops Constraint Matrix
summary: Compact working sheet that maps funnel KPIs to launch gates, operational constraints, and contingency actions for the Tealeaf feature pilot. Designed for product-ops + SRE crosswalk during the 2-week canary and first 24 hours of traffic scale.
content:
OBJECTIVE:
Quick, actionable readiness matrix that ties measurable KPI funnel thresholds to concrete runbook actions (who does what, when) and the capacity/latency risk map. Not a substitute for the full playbook but a condensed decision lattice for launch leads.

EXECUTIVE NOTES:
- Target pilot cohort: 5k DAU, expected 10 req/s peak per region.
- Primary owner: Priya Nair (product-ops) — escalation to SRE on threshold breaches.
- Canary window: 48 hours small cohort -> expand to 72 hours medium cohort -> open to all.

KPI FUNNEL (metric | baseline | pilot target | green threshold | amber | red trigger | owner):
- API success rate | 99.92% | >=99.9% | >=99.9% | 99.5%-99.9% | <99.5% | SRE (Ethan Brooks)
- P95 latency (ms, token-gen) | 320ms | <=350ms | <=350ms | 350-500ms | >500ms | Serving-runtime (Liam O'Connor)
- Token cost / 1k tokens (USD est) | $0.28 | <=$0.30 | <=$0.30 | $0.30-$0.40 | >$0.40 | Product Finance (Sofia Martinez)
- Model hallucination rate (eval set) | 3.1% | <=2.0% | <=2.0% | 2.0%-3.5% | >3.5% | Research/Applied ML (Maya Patel)
- Feature adoption (weekday 1) | 6% | >=8% | >=8% | 5%-8% | <5% | Growth PM
- Error rate by route (per 10k requests) | 12 | <=10 | <=10 | 10-30 | >30 | Product-ops

READINESS GATES (gate name | must-pass checks | who signs off | fallback):
- Gate A: Canary start | infra smoke OK, canary tokens loaded, alerting hooks wired, runbook assigned | Priya Nair + Ethan | Pause canary, rollback config, route traffic to fallback model variant
- Gate B: Canary scale (48h) | P95 latency & success green, no security alerts, billing estimate within 5% of forecast | Priya + Liam + Finance | Throttle traffic, reduce batch size, enable caching
- Gate C: Full ramp | SLA monitor green for 24h, rollout controls tested, on-call rotation staffed | Head of Product-ops + SRE lead | Gradual slow-rollback with traffic holdback to 20%

OPERATIONAL CONSTRAINTS & PRIORITIZATION (constraint | impact | mitigation):
- GPU pool cold startup times | High impact on 1st-request latency | Pre-warm pools, reserve 1 shard for pilot, set autoscale buffer to +20%
- Tokenization variance across locales | Medium impact on cost estimates | Use normalized token calculator, set conservative cost ceiling
- KV cache warm-up | High impact on latency for repeated prefix traffic | Seed cache during canary with synthetic replay, enable prefix caching flag

CONTINGENCY TRIGGERS & PLAYBOOK (trigger | immediate action | owner | comms):
- P95 > 600ms for 5m window: reduce burst concurrency by 30%, flip to compatible quantized model variant, page SRE -> Ethan, notify #incident
- Success rate drop > 1% absolute in 15m: rollback last config change, enable canary holdback, start quick failure triage (product-ops + SRE)
- Cost per 1k tokens > target by 30% projected: throttle non-critical routes, switch to lower-cost routing policy, notify finance (Sofia)
- Hallucination spike (>4% on eval set checks): enable stricter prompt templates, disable open-tooling, notify applied-ml (Maya) and pause rollout

TESTING & VALIDATION CHECKLIST (prelaunch quick items):
- [ ] Canary credential rotation validated
- [ ] End-to-end smoke tests for each region (latency + correctness)
- [ ] Traces instrumented per route, sampling at 10%
- [ ] Observability dashboards: P95, success, error by route, cost burn, model-quality judge panel
- [ ] Load test script: 2x expected pilot peak for 10m
- [ ] Failover path tested (switch to fallback model)

COMMUNICATION & ESCALATION (who to ping first):
- Ops page: #product-ops (Priya)
- SRE escalation: Ethan Brooks (pager)
- Model quality: Maya Patel
- Finance alert: Sofia Martinez
- Exec brief if red for >1h: Head of Product + VP Eng

SAMPLE ASSUMPTIONS / NUMBERS USED FOR DECISIONS:
- Expected average request tokens: 220 tokens/request
- Predicted pilot cost burn (first week): $4.2k - $5.8k depending on sampling and caching hit rate
- Warm cache hit target: 60% after 24h synthetic seeding

OPEN QUESTIONS & NOTES TO SELF:
- Do we need additional SRE rotation nights for first 72h? (pause: check on-call capacity)
- Add a short customer-facing FAQ for pilot opt-in users about observed latency variance
- Validate regional cost delta for APAC before enabling full region in week 2

NEXT STEPS (action owners):
- Priya: finalize canary cohort list + invite beta customers (due 2026-03-12)
- Liam: pre-warm GPU shards and run 2x load test (due 2026-03-11)
- Ethan: ensure alerting runbooks are loaded into PagerDuty and test escalation (due 2026-03-10)
- Maya: quick re-run of hallucination eval with updated prompt templates (due 2026-03-09)
- Sofia: confirm budget approval and set spend guardrails (due 2026-03-11)

QUICK HISTORY (notes preserved):
- 2026-02-20: initial hypothesis sketch (lower token costs thru caching + quantized variant)
- 2026-02-25: first SRE feasibility sync - decided to reserve a GPU shard for pilot
- 2026-02-27: updated P95 target after serving-runtime micro-optimizations

RISK LOG (short):
- Major dependency: serving-runtime kernel upgrade scheduled week of launch — coordinate rollback window in case of perf regressions.
- Customer-visible risk: early users may see inconsistent latency across regions until caches warm. Communicate expectation.

NOTES TO FUTURE SELF:
- If pilot shows cost variance >20% from forecast, require exec sign-off before full ramp.
- Save final canary dashboard snapshot before any rollback action.

-- work-in-progress — use this as the single source for quick go/no-go decisions during the Tealeaf pilot. Update the confluence brief with final signoff checklist once Gate C passes.
